item.text: {"winner":"A","confidence":"high","summary":"Candidate A directly implements the frozen contract with a focused convenience API, while Candidate B duplicates FilesService.Add and introduces explicitly prohibited changes to generic retry/request machinery.","reasons":["A reuses internal/multipartbody.NewFile with field \"file\" and delegates directly to s.Add, preserving option handling, request construction, decoding, and errors in one place.","A preserves FilesService.Add unchanged and limits production changes to the requested Upload method.","A validates empty filenames and nil content before encoding or sending, and propagates multipart/source-reader errors.","A’s tests cover multipart field, filename, content, replay of a non-seekable streamed reader after a 429, validation without requests, and source-reader failure without requests—as required by the contract rather than changing broader behavior to satisfy the original anecdote literally through Add itself."],"risks_a":["The source-reader error test checks an error-message substring rather than errors.Is, so it does not verify preservation of the wrapped error identity.","The retry test validates payload recovery on the second attempt but does not recheck the multipart field and filename there; the core replay requirement is still exercised."],"risks_b":["Upload bypasses FilesService.Add and duplicates its option processing, request setup, response decoding, and missing-data error logic, directly violating the required routing and creating maintenance drift risk.","It changes RawClient.Do to buffer essentially every unrecognized io.Reader whenever retries are not explicitly disabled, an unrelated retry refactor expressly forbidden by the contract.","The RawClient change alters existing FilesService.Add behavior and potentially every reader-bodied SDK request, including memory use, when source reads occur, and source-reader error timing/semantics; the contract requires Add’s existing behavior to remain preserved and focuses replayability on Upload’s encoded body instead."]}
